context: Removal of excess saliva during application minimizes dilution of the anesthetic and permits maximum penetration. Not more than one ounce (28g) per patient should be applied during a 24 hour period. Contains: Lidocaine 8%, Dibucaine 0.8% In a flavored aqueous base. Net Contents 30g
